question: What should I know about the boss past the crystal spike area in Hollow Knight, the one that looks just like me?
reply: Alright, listen up. You wanna know about that infected husk boss, the one that looks like you? Right, that Broken Vessel. It ain't just some weak little bug you gotta run into. This fella is tough. You gotta watch his moves. He dashes with those slashes that cover most of the arena, and he throws these big blobs when his health dips low. The key here is timing your moves. When he starts that big cascade of infection, you gotta use Desolate Dive to keep yourself safe while you deal with the damage. And when he gets staggered, that's your window. You gotta heal him up while he's shaky, head weighted down. Don't just swing wildly; you gotta be smart about when you hit and when you dodge. It's all about reading his rhythm, see? — No close match in my notes, this answer leans on the model's own knowledge.
